title: I put life's pressure on others, I don't take it myself: Salman on how he handles life's pressure | Bakwas hai: Salman on reports | Inshorts
text:
I put life's pressure on others, I don't take it myself: Salman on how he handles life's pressure 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone I put life's pressure on others, I don't take it myself: Salman on how he handles life's pressure
 short by Arshiya Chopra / 03:40 pm on Saturday, 7 November, 2026 Actor Salman Khan responded after a reporter asked him how he handles pressures he is facing in his life currently. "Mein life ka pressure dusro ko deta hu, khud nai leta" (I pass the pressure of life on to others, I don't take it on myself)," Salman said. He also dismissed reports of facing government pressure to change 'Maatrubhumi' script. read more at ANI Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
